description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
💎 Improvements
- Resource Lists: Added a new animated download icon when we're connected to the apiserver, but Aptakube is still download the data.
- Port Forwarding: Improved the Port Forwards manager to support longer resource names.
🐞 Fixes
- Health: Fixed a flash of content on the Pod Status at the cluster health page
- macOS: Fixed the window opening at a different size and position on every launch, mostly with a Retina screen and an external monitor. It also no longer grows by the title bar's height each time
- Windows: Taskbar pins no longer lose their icon after an update.
